arms.G1: full-sequence search; first fixed Top-3 view; actual v2 fallback
arms.G3: same fixed Top-3; original successful-view static-area aggregation; actual v2 fallback
arms.U2: genuine archived Native-selected single observation; original signed pooling; no v2 fallback

G_model.rho: mean sigmoid membership logits over valid tokens of a group

R_model.initial_reference: same initialization, eval, frozen, retained with checkpoint

coverage.early_negative: no new full-map rows, no G/H2/real-proposal generation, publish R evidence and exact reason

data.H2_exclude: parent exclusions + all 32 parent families + all known project exposures
data.H2_parse_annotations_after: both seed nominations and all scientific predictors locked

real_proposal.GT_free_retention: pixels>=100, bbox>=2; sort predicted_iou descending, stability descending, pixel_count descending, mask_digest ascending
real_proposal.frame_indices: 0 and floor((n-1)/2) in recorded sorted DEV frame bank; deduplicate

loss.G_preservation: inherit Rstar preservation flag for all G methods
loss.membership_reduction: known-token BCE mean within each original object, then batch mean
loss.teacher_condition: TRAIN clean ordinary FC full200 top1 equals TRAIN target, same view prefix
loss.teacher_reference: detached clean ordinary FC normalized embedding

observation.geometry: exact parent predicted maps or frozen GT-derived supervised proposals

publication.weights: all selected trained heads plus frozen initial reference and frozen base dependencies; never FC backbone

resources.device: one available A40, inherited GPU lock

selection.A: equal-family mean per-original (0.5 clean correct + sum 3 corrupt correct /6)
selection.CE: equal-family base160 weighted CE, tie-break only
selection.DEV: base-category objects, full200 competitors, frozen existing four variants
selection.G_nomination: best main-seed G satisfying M,C nondecrease and A gain>=0.005 vs frozen Rstar; otherwise Rstar
selection.G_repeat: all five G architectures seed29 with its own frozen Rstar, no architecture switch
selection.G_start: both R seeds pass R_gate; else completed negative early exit
selection.M: equal-class mean of the same per-original weighted correctness
selection.Rstar: best admissible checkpoint/method; tie R0,R1,R2,R3; freeze architecture before repeat
selection.repeat_R: same Rstar architecture seed29, independently DEV-selected checkpoint, same R_gate
